title: The Rainkeeper's Archive
goal: Open the archive by restoring the correct flow of rainwater, or locate its maintenance access.
worldPurpose: An old canal guild secured flood-control records behind an apparatus that requires knowledge of the waterworks.

clues.playerText: A weathered mural shows the oldest channel feeding the reservoir before the spillway.
The gear teeth are polished only where the reservoir mark would align.
A maintenance ledger says the reservoir always receives the first flow.
A rectangular seam runs behind a loose line of copper rivets.

actions.feedback: The mural's river route becomes clear; the first flow belongs to the reservoir.
The gear wear confirms a preferred direction toward the reservoir.
The maintenance record names the reservoir as the first destination.
The dial settles into its worn track with a quiet click.
A concealed lock lifts. The archive doors open.
Behind the copper rivets is a human-sized maintenance hatch.
The hatch swings inward, revealing a service crawlspace.
You reach the archive from the maintenance side.

hints.text: The engraved river and the dial's worn track seem related.
The reservoir symbol marks the intended first destination of the flow.
Try aligning the dial to the reservoir mark before pulling the release.

feedbackOnInvalidAction: That approach has no effect here. You can inspect the mural, gear, ledger, rivets, dial or chain.
fallback: Players can discover and open the service hatch; no timed input or scarce unique item is needed.
resets: Persistent within a world instance until an explicitly approved content/instance reset.
confidentiality: The example stores simple flags for finite-state testing; production must separate character discoveries from shared apparatus state.
notes: Editorial test fixture only. NOT importable by MUDD unless a real compatible public authoring API is separately implemented.
